content: The American Diabetes Association recommends the use of standardized, single-page glucose reports generated by continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) devices. These reports should include visual aids, such as the ambulatory glucose profile, and should serve as a standard summary format for all CGM devices. Time in Range (TIR) is an important metric as it correlates with the risk of developing microvascular complications. TIR can be utilized to assess a patient’s overall glycemic control. Furthermore, the metrics of time spent below the target glucose range and time spent above the target glucose range are valuable for evaluating and optimizing the effectiveness of a patient’s treatment plan.
